subject: Onboarding paperwork + PO pathing for CloudConsortium listing
messages:
From: Alyssa Green <procurement@cloudconsortium.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Markus Lane <markus.lane@cloudconsortium.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing — vendor onboarding items and PO timing

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — CloudConsortium is excited to get Redwood listed in our marketplace. Before we can issue a PO we need: a vendor packet (W-9 + banking instructions + signable MSA), SOC2 evidence URL, and your standard invoice template. Can you confirm expected timelines for the paperwork and whether you support Net30 via purchase order?

Also sharing our internal vendor ID (CC-V-2248) — procurement will route the PO once the packet is received.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Green
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudConsortium
procurement@cloudconsortium.com

---
Attachment: vendor_intake_requirements.txt (text)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Green <procurement@cloudconsortium.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing — vendor onboarding items and PO timing

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you remotely yesterday. Thank you for the checklist. Short answers below and next steps: 

- Vendor packet: I attached our Redwood Marketplace Vendor Packet (includes W-9, banking instructions, and the latest MSA).
- SOC2 evidence: we host a read-only evidence binder at the link in the packet; if you need a time-limited access token I can create one.
- Invoice template: attached (standard monthly billing via PO).
- Net30: Yes, we support Net30 on PO'd marketplace deals — exceptions can be routed via finance for earlier payment terms.

Next steps I propose: 1) You confirm any redlines to the MSA, 2) we provide SOC2 time-limited access if required, 3) procurement issues PO referencing CC-V-2248 and deal CC-4872.

Copying Vanessa (Finance ops) and Kimberly (Marketplace listings) to coordinate the PO routing and legal touchpoints.

Thanks — Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_vendor_packet.pdf; redwood_invoice_template.xlsx
From: Markus Lane <markus.lane@cloudconsortium.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Alyssa Green <procurement@cloudconsortium.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing — vendor onboarding items and PO timing

Vanessa / Rishi — quick clarifying question from our AP team: the banking instructions in your packet list both ACH and SWIFT details. For a marketplace PO we typically do ACH (USD). Can you confirm the preferred remittance account for ACH and whether you require an invoice reference format (we use CC-V-2248 + invoice number)?

Also, we have a standard PO template (attached) — we'll populate and send once legal confirms the MSA.

Regards,
Markus Lane
Director, Finance Operations | CloudConsortium

Attachment: cloudconsortium_po_template.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Markus Lane <markus.lane@cloudconsortium.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing — vendor onboarding items and PO timing

Thanks Markus — happy to confirm.

- Preferred remittance: Redwood Inference, ACH to account ending **4321**, Routing 121000358 (same as in the packet). Please use the invoice reference: CC-V-2248 / [invoice number].
- Invoice submission: please send the PO and the first invoice to ap@redwood.com; include the HubSpot deal id (CC-4872) in the invoice notes to tie billing to the marketplace listing.
- Timing: once legal clears any MSA redlines we expect to receive the PO within 48 business hours; with a PO in hand our billing team will queue the first invoice according to the billing schedule in the packet.

Kimberly — can you confirm there are no additional marketplace-commerce onboarding forms required from our side (tax or product data) beyond the packet we sent? If there are, please flag them here so we can attach to the PO.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Finance & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_ach_confirmation.pdf
From: Alyssa Green <procurement@cloudconsortium.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Markus Lane <markus.lane@cloudconsortium.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, docs@cloudconsortium.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing — vendor onboarding items and PO timing

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround. Our legal reviewed the MSA and made two small requests (see attached redline doc). I'll send the populated PO today after we reconcile the redlines; expected PO number CC-PO-9921.

Two quick asks for the records team before we close: 1) can you provide a short one-paragraph description of the product listing (100–150 words) and 2) confirm whether you allow prefunded credits for marketplace trials (yes/no). We'll include both on the PO and in the listing metadata.

I'll attach the signed/approved PO to the HubSpot deal and share the DocuSign link if legal needs a signature flow.

Best,
Alyssa

Attachment: cc_msa_redlines_20280614.docx
